summary: Implemented drag-and-drop reordering for sidebar workspaces and workbench inspector tabs. Workspace order persists server-side via a new `project.reorder` protocol request handled by ProjectCatalog; inspector tab order persists client-side in app settings. Verified in the browser that both lists reorder and survive reload, then restored the original order.
decisions: Workspace reorder persists server-side via a new `project.reorder` request handled in ProjectCatalog, rather than client-only, because projects already round-trip through the agent.
Inspector tab reorder persists client-side in AppSettings (localStorage), since tabs are a UI concern not known to the agent.
Drag-and-drop uses native HTML5 drag events with a DataTransfer object on `[data-ui="workspace-row"]` and `[data-ui="tabs-trigger"]` elements.
The dev server hosts the agent in-process without watching server-side files, so protocol/schema changes require an explicit `pnpm dev:server:restart` to take effect.
errors: The dev server kept rejecting the new `project.reorder` request with `Invalid agent protocol request` from `websocket/transport.ts` because the in-process agent was still running the old protocol schema; the optimistic client update reverted, making the drag appear to do nothing.
A JavaScript test script errored with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getBoundingClientRect')` when a row element was not yet rendered.
Chrome tab showed an error page mid-reload after the dev server restart, requiring a fresh navigation before re-running the drag verification.
